# refresh fork

Add a command that brings a fork's copies up to date with its parent: fetch everything, then push every `upstream` branch and every tag to `origin` and to the `mirror`.

```bash
$ git fetch --all --prune --force
$ git push origin 'refs/remotes/upstream/*:refs/heads/*'
$ git push mirror 'refs/remotes/upstream/*:refs/heads/*'
$ git push origin 'refs/tags/*:refs/tags/*'
$ git push mirror 'refs/tags/*:refs/tags/*'
```

This is the fork-maintenance routine of the author's `upstream` + `origin` + `mirror` layout ([[DOT-137]]): the refspecs copy branches wholesale, so it is only safe for forks that carry no branches of their own with the same names.
